name: Bank Reconciliation for Mexican PyMEs - Complete Architecture

meta.description: Comprehensive bank reconciliation automation for Mexican SMEs with multi-bank support (BBVA, Santander, Banorte), PDF/CSV processing, transaction matching, and accounting integration

parameters.prompt:
Extract transaction data from this Mexican bank statement PDF. Return structured JSON with:
- accountNumber
- bankName (BBVA, Santander, Banorte, etc.)
- statementDate
- transactions array with: date, description, amount, balance, reference
- currency (MXN assumed)
Ensure dates are in YYYY-MM-DD format and amounts are numeric.

parameters.functionCode:
const data = $input.first().json; const { summary, matches, discrepancies, analysis } = data; // Generate HTML report const htmlReport = ` Reporte de Conciliación Bancaria

Reporte de Conciliación Bancaria

Fecha de procesamiento: ${new Date().toLocaleString('es-MX')}

Nivel de riesgo: ${analysis.riskLevel.toUpperCase()}

Transacciones Bancarias
${summary.totalBankTransactions}
Registros Internos
${summary.totalInternalRecords}
Conciliadas
${summary.matchedCount}
Tasa de Conciliación
${summary.reconciliationRate.toFixed(1)}%
${analysis.criticalIssues.length > 0 ? `

Problemas Críticos

${analysis.criticalIssues.map(issue => `
${issue.type}: ${issue.message}
`).join('')}
` : ''} ${analysis.warnings.length > 0 ? `

Advertencias

${analysis.warnings.map(warning => `
${warning.type}: ${warning.message}
`).join('')}
` : ''} ${discrepancies.unmatchedBank.length > 0 ? `

Transacciones Bancarias sin Conciliar

${discrepancies.unmatchedBank.map(item => ` `).join('')}
Fecha Descripción Monto Referencia
${item.bankTransaction.date} ${item.bankTransaction.description} $${Math.abs(item.bankTransaction.amount).toLocaleString('es-MX')} ${item.bankTransaction.reference}
` : ''} ${discrepancies.unmatchedInternal.length > 0 ? `

Registros Internos sin Conciliar

${discrepancies.unmatchedInternal.map(item => ` `).join('')}
Fecha Descripción Monto Referencia
${item.internalTransaction.transaction_date} ${item.internalTransaction.description} $${Math.abs(item.internalTransaction.amount).toLocaleString('es-MX')} ${item.internalTransaction.reference || 'N/A'}
` : ''}

Recomendaciones

    ${analysis.recommendations.map(rec => `
  • ${rec}
    • `).join('')}

Transacciones Conciliadas (Muestra)

${matches.slice(0, 10).map(match => ` `).join('')}
Fecha Banco Fecha Interna Descripción Monto Confianza
${match.bankTransaction.date} ${match.internalTransaction.transaction_date} ${match.bankTransaction.description} $${Math.abs(match.bankTransaction.amount).toLocaleString('es-MX')} ${match.matchScore.toFixed(0)}%
${matches.length > 10 ? `

Mostrando 10 de ${matches.length} transacciones conciliadas

` : ''}
`; // Generate CSV export for detailed analysis const csvData = [ ['Tipo', 'Fecha', 'Descripción', 'Monto', 'Referencia', 'Estado', 'Confianza'], ...matches.map(m => [ 'Conciliada', m.bankTransaction.date, m.bankTransaction.description, m.bankTransaction.amount, m.bankTransaction.reference, m.status, `${m.matchScore.toFixed(0)}%` ]), ...discrepancies.unmatchedBank.map(u => [ 'Sin conciliar - Banco', u.bankTransaction.date, u.bankTransaction.description, u.bankTransaction.amount, u.bankTransaction.reference, u.status, 'N/A' ]), ...discrepancies.unmatchedInternal.map(u => [ 'Sin conciliar - Interno', u.internalTransaction.transaction_date, u.internalTransaction.description, u.internalTransaction.amount, u.internalTransaction.reference || 'N/A', u.status, 'N/A' ]) ]; const csvContent = csvData.map(row => row.map(cell => `"${cell}"`).join(',')).join('\n'); return [{ json: { reportData: data, htmlReport, csvContent, fileName: `conciliacion_bancaria_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.html`, csvFileName: `conciliacion_bancaria_detalle_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv` } }];

additionalFields.Line: ={{ $json.reportData.matches.map(match => ({ Description: match.bankTransaction.description, Amount: Math.abs(match.bankTransaction.amount), DetailType: match.bankTransaction.amount > 0 ? 'CreditLineDetail' : 'DebitLineDetail' })) }}
